_notice: Where Sofia looks for new changes each morning. Speciality news (Marcus), tenders and awards (Helen), digital assurance (Grace) and safety alerts (Regulatory Desk) are deliberately left out. Meaning lines are information only.

watched.name: MHRA, register medical devices
watched.meaning: This page sets who registers a device, and the fees, before it can be sold in the United Kingdom.

watched.name: MHRA, regulating medical devices
watched.meaning: This page sets the legal basis for placing a device on the Great Britain market.

watched.name: MHRA, devices in Northern Ireland
watched.meaning: This page covers the separate rules for supplying devices to Northern Ireland.

watched.name: MHRA, future device regime
watched.meaning: This page tracks upcoming amendments to the Great Britain device regulations.

watched.name: MHRA, CE marking timelines
watched.meaning: This page covers how long CE marked devices are accepted in Great Britain.

watched.name: MHRA, post-market surveillance
watched.meaning: This page sets what manufacturers monitor and report once a device is in use.

watched.name: MHRA, legal requirements
watched.meaning: This page covers the legal requirements for supplying devices in Great Britain.

watched.name: MHRA, clinical investigations
watched.meaning: This page affects companies gathering clinical evidence for a device in the United Kingdom.

watched.name: MHRA, exceptional use authorisations
watched.meaning: These authorisations let named devices be supplied without the usual marking for a limited time, which changes what is available to a buyer.

watched.name: Cabinet Office, Procurement Policy Notes
watched.meaning: A Procurement Policy Note can change what a public buyer asks of bidders.

watched.name: Cabinet Office, social value model
watched.meaning: This affects how social value is scored in central government tenders.

watched.name: Cabinet Office, carbon reduction plans
watched.meaning: This affects the carbon reduction plan a bidder for major government contracts provides.

watched.name: Department of Health and Social Care, value based procurement
watched.meaning: This affects how NHS buyers score medical technology tenders.

watched.name: Department of Health and Social Care, industry payments
watched.meaning: This affects how payments from device and medicines companies to healthcare are reported.
